Lists hints newest first, a page at a time. `cursor` is the opaque
`nextCursor` of the previous page; a response without `nextCursor` is the
last page. Optional filters narrow by station, site and state.
`limit` and `cursor` may each be given once; an empty or repeated `limit`
is `invalid-limit`, a repeated `cursor` is `invalid-cursor`, and a query
parameter this operation does not declare is `unknown-query-parameter`.
